question: Which form of recitation is ranked highest within the threefold classification of japa?
premises: Recitation is declared to be threefold.
Mental recitation is named as the highest.
This teaching is addressed to the Goddess.
inference: Among the three kinds of japa, mental recitation is taught as the highest.
uncertainties: The other two kinds of japa are not named in this verse.
plain_english: O Goddess, recitation is declared to be threefold, and mental recitation is the highest.
